# AddyOsmani.com

> > Addy Osmani's personal site exploring AI-assisted software engineering, agentic development practices, and lessons from a decade at Google.

AddyOsmani.com is the professional hub of Addy Osmani, a Software Engineer at Google Cloud AI, sharing insights on AI coding agents, engineering leadership, and the future of software development. The site combines technical guides, research-backed analyses, and talks on managing AI-assisted workflows and building effective engineering teams.

## Key Topics

- AI Coding Agents
- Agentic Engineering
- Claude Code
- LLM Workflows
- Code Review & Verification
- Agent Orchestration
- Engineering Leadership
- Comprehension Debt
- AI-Assisted Development
- Self-Improving Agents
- Team Building
- Google Cloud AI
- Software Engineering Practices
- Spec Writing for AI
- Future of Coding

## AI Coding Agents & Workflows

- [Agentic Engineering](https://addyosmani.com/blog/agentic-engineering): Disciplined approach to AI-assisted software development with human oversight
- [My LLM coding workflow going into 2026](https://addyosmani.com/blog/ai-coding-workflow): Practical workflow guide for AI-assisted coding with Claude Code
- [Self-Improving Coding Agents](https://addyosmani.com/blog/self-improving-agents): Autonomous AI coding agents that continuously improve and self-iterate
- [Claude Code Swarms](https://addyosmani.com/blog/claude-code-agent-teams): Claude Code agent teams and coordinated swarms for parallel development
- [Your AI coding agents need a manager](https://addyosmani.com/blog/coding-agents-manager): Managing parallel AI coding agents as async-first engineering practice
- [How to write a good spec for AI agents](https://addyosmani.com/blog/good-spec): Guide to writing effective specifications for AI coding agents

## AI Impact on Software Engineering

- [The Factory Model: How Coding Agents Changed Software Engineering](https://addyosmani.com/blog/factory-model): How AI coding agents are transforming software engineering practices
- [The Next Two Years of Software Engineering](https://addyosmani.com/blog/next-two-years): Predictions on AI impact, hiring, and software engineering trends through 2026
- [AI writes code faster. Your job is still to prove it works.](https://addyosmani.com/blog/code-review-ai): Code review practices and verification strategies in AI-assisted development
- [Comprehension Debt - the hidden cost of AI generated code.](https://addyosmani.com/blog/comprehension-debt): Analysis of cognitive costs and technical debt from AI-generated code
- [Stop Using /init for AGENTS.md](https://addyosmani.com/blog/agents-md): Research-backed analysis on optimizing AGENTS.md for LLM agent performance
- [AI-Assisted Engineering: A 2019 Perspective on the Next Decade of Coding](https://addyosmani.com/blog/ai-assisted-engineering-idea): 2019 perspective on AI-assisted engineering and machine learning in coding

## Engineering Leadership & Team Building

- [Software Engineering - The Soft Parts](https://addyosmani.com/blog/software-engineering-soft-parts): Soft skills and leadership lessons from 10 years at Google Chrome
